fields.label: Total Effective Erosion Rate File
fields.help:
Indicate the file containing total effective erosion rate information. You may later choose to manually enter values on the screen for certain parameters, 
	rather than use the file. This file must contain the names of the surface parcels as well as values for the erosion parameters you wish to provide. 
	Any required parameters that are not imported will be assigned default values which you can later update
